_provenance: Per-90 rates are informed priors for the squads as of the 2026/27 season start. IMPORTANT: 'fouls' is fouls COMMITTED, not fouls suffered - that is the market this model prices. cardProneness scales the per-foul booking hazard for players who foul cynically or tactically. startProb/benchProb are selection estimates and are the single most valuable thing to refresh once team news drops about an hour before kick-off.
_refresh: Update startProb/benchProb from confirmed line-ups via scripts/set-lineups.js, or edit in place. Everything downstream re-prices automatically.
_roles: roleType maps each player to an archetype in roles.json, which supplies every per-90 metric not listed explicitly below. flank drives the positional matchup model; pace feeds duel outcomes; setPieces are shares of the team's penalties, direct free kicks and corners.
